EXPLICIT RATIONAL SQUARES FOR THE FINAL RAYLEIGH DIFFERENCE

Element pair: (0,9). Remaining variables are x1,...,x8.
q = F_10 F_01 - F_00 F_11 = sum over l of w_l L_l^2.
All coefficients below are exact rational numbers; every w_l is positive.
The independent and complementary checkers verify the full expansion.
